title: UFO: Unfair-to-Fair Evolving Mitigates Unfairness in LLM-based Recommender Systems via Self-Play Fine-tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness (specifically Item-side Fairness) and equitable treatment in AI recommender systems. It evaluates and benchmarks its proposed framework using fairness metrics such as Mean Group Unfairness (MGU) and Disparity Group Unfairness (DGU), which are quantitative measures of ethical performance in algorithmic systems.
